title: Ultrasound Watermark: Real-time Acoustic Watermarking against Voice Scams on Smartphones
abstract: arXiv:2611.30106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in text-to-speech (TTS), voice conversion (VC), and AI-driven speech synthesis enable adversaries to convincingly impersonate trusted individuals during phone calls. Existing defenses often rely on offline analysis, degrade under telephony distortions, or remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks. To address these limitations, we present Ultrasound Watermark, a real-time, smartphone-native framework that protects live calls by binding speech to the caller's physical articulatory motion through acoustic watermarking. During a call, the smartphone emits ultrasonic signals and captures reflections from facial articulatory movements using only its built-in speaker and microphone. Ultrasound Watermark extracts motion features from these reflections and fuses them with outgoing speech to generate a dynamic watermark. translated_title: 超声波水印：针对智能手机语音诈骗的实时声学水印技术
translated_abstract: 文本转语音（TTS）、语音转换（VC）以及AI驱动的语音合成技术的最新进展，使攻击者能够在电话通话中令人信服地冒充受信任的个人。现有的防御措施通常依赖离线分析，在电话信道失真下性能下降，或仍易受自适应攻击的影响。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了Ultrasound Watermark，一个实时、智能手机原生的框架，通过声学水印将语音与通话者的物理发音动作绑定，从而保护实时通话。在通话过程中，智能手机发射超声波信号，并仅利用其内置扬声器和麦克风捕获面部发音动作产生的反射。Ultrasound Watermark从这些反射中提取运动特征，并将其与外发语音融合以生成动态水印。由于超声波测量与语音产生在物理和时间上紧密耦合，它们很难……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Ultrasound Watermark框架，利用智能手机内置扬声器发射超声波并采集面部发音动作的反射，将说话者的物理发音运动与语音绑定生成动态水印，实现实时防御AI语音合成带来的电话诈骗。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Ultrasound Watermark, a real-time smartphone-native framework that binds speech to the caller's facial articulatory motion via ultrasonic sensing, generating dynamic watermarks to defend live calls against AI-driven voice scams.
